Team —

Thanks for the quick triage, Dylan and Mina. Given Catalyst is reporting customer impact and this is a paid integration under deal DL-7832, I'm escalating to our partner response lead and looping Aditya for awareness on potential credit/expedite requests.

Short-term mitigation options we've discussed:
- Catalyst: temporary backoff + request-header passthrough rollback on their proxy (quickest fix if feasible).
- Redwood: add a tolerant parsing path to skip missing header checks for a short window (low-risk, quick deploy).
- Both: enable a proxy-level retry with jitter to avoid synchronized retries.

Please confirm which of the above Catalyst can action this morning; if not, we'll push the tolerant parsing as a hotfix and align on postmortem. I've attached a zipped dump of the correlated logs we collected: redwood-dump-logs-20270629.zip

Also, we should schedule a short postmortem once stabilized to review SLA implications and mitigation playbook for partners.

Marissa Cole

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RESOLVED: Catalyst webhook failures — root cause and next steps

Update and resolution summary:

Root cause: A recent change in Catalyst's outbound proxy configuration stripped the X-Redwood-Signature header for a subset of requests. Our signature verification returned null and triggered a 500.

What happened:
- Catalyst rolled a proxy config that removed a non-standard header for requests routed through their new edge (affected ~12% of traffic).
- Redwood's verification path did not tolerate a missing header and threw an internal error instead of returning a 4xx, which escalated the failure mode.

Actions taken (completed):
- Catalyst deployed a rollback to re-add header passthrough at 07:15 PDT on 2027-06-30.
- Redwood pushed a short-lived tolerant-parsing hotfix at 07:40 PDT to gracefully reject missing signatures with a 401 instead of 500.
- We validated delivery success for the affected customers and monitored for 24 hours.

Open items / next steps:
- Joint postmortem call (30–45 min) — propose Thu 2027-07-01 10:00 PDT.
- Follow-up patch to harden verification to log missing headers with non-fatal path by 2027-07-07.
- Agree SLAs on partner config changes and a 72-hour notification window for infra changes affecting headers.

Thanks to the Catalyst team and our on-call SREs for the quick turnaround. Closing JIRA INF-4521 with notes; I'll post the postmortem link to the Drive and HubSpot record.

— Mina
